In this video, we delve into the life and legacy of Rajiv Dixit (राजीव दीक्षित), a prominent figure who passionately promoted Ayurveda and opposed modern medicine and multinational corporations. Born on November 30, 1967, in Nah, Aligarh district, India, Rajiv Dixit completed his early education in Firozabad and later pursued higher studies in Prayagraj (Allahabad). However, he became an activist before completing his formal education.

Dixit founded the “Azadi Bachao Andolan” (Save Freedom Movement) in the early 1990s, advocating for the protection of Indian industries amidst the rise of multinational corporations. As a national secretary of Ramdev’s anti-corruption organization, Bharat Swabhiman Andolan, he demanded decentralization of the Indian taxation system, highlighting bureaucratic corruption. His controversial academic credentials were later exposed as fraudulent.

Tragically, on November 30, 2010, Rajiv Dixit passed away in Bhilai, Chhattisgarh. His death remains shrouded in mystery, with some followers believing he was poisoned due to his activism against multinational companies. Join us as we pay tribute to this remarkable individual and explore the enigma surrounding his untimely demise.
